g.title: G
g.text: Two digests, one wire field — the protocol_digest (MD5, on wire) vs. the internal dispatch-table hash (SHA-1, at +0x130)

g.title: layout
g.text: wire field — the version commitment server gates on
This is the value to match.

Source: §2.4 R16 (live capture 2026-05-15) + Track B mercury-section-2-track-b-evidence Investigation 6 + mercury-section-2-live-capture-findings (Gap B closure). Earlier drafts conflated the two hashes because both are uppercase hex produced by CryptoPP HexEncoder and both live in adjacent code paths inside logOnBegin; the AteraLoader session log's literal `protocol_digest: ...` field at logOnBegin entry is the authoritative evidence that the 32-char MD5 is the on-wire value.
